Golden Designs Catalonia model GDI 6880 02 Elite — an 8-person ultra-low EMF far infrared sauna built with reforested Canadian Hemlock wood and designed for high-capacity use and shared wellness. The first 205 characters emphasise the large capacity, ultra-low EMF heating system, and premium construction.

Inside you’ll find eight custom-designed comfort benches, 23 PureTech™ near-zero EMF carbon heating panels (EMF under ~2–3 milligauss at 2–3 inches from emitters), a bronze-tinted tempered glass door, Bluetooth audio with built-in speakers, a star-galaxy chromotherapy ceiling light system, and an interior/exterior LED control panel. With a spacious floor plan, wheelchair-accessible door setup and convertible layout (benches removable for yoga or stretching), this sauna fits families, couples or wellness groups. The required electrical service is 240 V / 30 A dedicated circuit, making professional installation advisable.

If you’re setting up a home spa, fitness recovery zone, or multi-user wellness space, the Catalonia Elite offers premium size, performance and materials for elevated infrared sauna use.
